items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with Art for a little while

ctx.x: You know who else was like that?-- Art Blakey! I told him he should have been a playwright. He was dramatic, he could hold your attention.
Yeah he was something. If he showed up late--I worked with Art for a little while--he would say, “The subway ran into a bus.”

He’d tell the audience and when he finished he said, “and I’m the only son of Mr. and Mrs. Blakey and I will play for you as long as you want” and people forgot all about the hour and a half they waited.
